def filter_slaves(selfie, slaves):
        """
        Remove slaves that are in an ODOWN or SDOWN state
        also remove slaves that do not have 'ok' master-link-status
        """
        slaves = slaves.splitlines()
        slaves = [i.split() for i in slaves]

        slaves = [i for i in slaves if i[3] != 'ODOWN' and i[3] != 'SDOWN']
        slaves = [i for i in slaves if i[2] == 'ok']

        return '\n'.join([' '.join(i) for i in slaves])
